title: Celebrated at birth, pushed into sex work

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: Savitri, a 40-year-old former sex worker, ... her elder daughter works with an NGO and is preparing to write the police exam, while her younger daughter is preparing for medical entrance tests in Indore.
